web.description: Discover authenticated website accounts and contexts. Required with login when authenticated actions are supported; public-only sites may omit both. Copy real descriptors into invocation.session; never fabricate accounts.

Log in to the website. Pass account as { $secret: key } from ox.service.inspect secrets to log in automatically with that saved login; use the only associated login by default, ask the user to pick when several exist, and omit account when none exists or the user asks to log in manually. Without account, or when automatic login cannot finish, the live login page is presented until the user taps Done; cancellation throws. Returns interaction: automatic with authentication: verified after a verified automatic login, otherwise interaction: completed with authentication: unverified. When it returns, the user has finished interacting: do not ask them to sign in or say done again. Discover fresh sessions before continuing the original task. Explain the sign-in step before invoking. Never request credentials in chat or replay writes after login.

account.description: Saved login reference { $secret: key } from ox.service.inspect secrets.

web.description: Optional read-only default website search. Scope and query syntax are website-specific; limits may be capped by the service. Reuse cursors with the same query and account. Null nextCursor does not prove completeness; failures are not empty results. Optional result data is service-specific.

api.description: Read credential configuration without prompting or contacting the API. Configured credentials are not verified server access.
Open Host-managed credential setup. Never request credentials in chat. Completion means configuration, not verified API access. Do not reopen after cancellation or replay writes.

mcp.description: Check server connectivity and authentication readiness without prompting or invoking tools. Connectivity is not tool authorization; errors are not absence.
Run the server's supported authorization flow through the Host. Available before tool discovery succeeds. Do not reopen after cancellation or replay writes.

ios.description: Read native permission state without prompting. OS permission is not account authentication.
Ask the user for the service's native OS permission through the Host. Do not reopen after cancellation or replay writes.
